<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="xouIzX4GUvJRjbvAZuZJ"> <mxGraphModel dx="3057" dy="1696" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "classDiagram
 direction LR
 class FrontendApp {
 +Quest list quests
 +loadQuests() void
 +addQuest() void
 }
 class QuestList {
 +Quest list quests
 +render() void
 }
 class ApiClient {
 +apiRequest(path, init) Promise
 }
 class Quest {
 <<interface>>
 +number id
 +string title
 +string description
 +QuestStatus status
 }
 class QuestCreate {
 <<type>>
 +string title
 +string description
 }
 class FastAPIApplication {
 <<module>>
 +include routers
 +manage database lifecycle
 }
 class QuestRoutes {
 <<module>>
 +createQuest(data)
 +listQuests(offset, limit)
 +getQuest(id)
 +updateQuest(id, data)
 +deleteQuest(id)
 }
 class AIRoutes {
 <<module>>
 +chat(request)
 }
 class QuestService {
 +createQuest(data) QuestRecord
 +getQuest(id) QuestRecord
 +listQuests() QuestRecord list
 +updateQuest(id, data) QuestRecord
 +deleteQuest(id) void
 }
 class QuestRepository {
 +create(data) QuestRecord
 +get(id) QuestRecord
 +list(offset, limit) QuestRecord list
 +update(quest, data) QuestRecord
 +delete(quest) void
 }
 class QuestRecord {
 <<SQLAlchemy entity>>
 +number id
 +string title
 +string description
 +string status
 }
 class Database {
 +start() void
 +stop() void
 +session() AsyncSession
 }
 class ChatRequest {
 +ChatMessage list messages
 }
 class ChatResponse {
 +string model
 +string response
 }
 class AIService {
 +chat(request) ChatResponse
 }
 class AIServiceError {
 +string message
 +number statusCode
 }
 class AIServiceApplication {
 <<module>>
 +health()
 +chat(data) AIChatResponse
 }
 class AIChatRequest {
 <<AI service DTO>>
 +AIChatMessage list messages
 }
 class AIChatResponse {
 <<AI service DTO>>
 +string model
 +string response
 }
 class PostgreSQL {
 <<external system>>
 }
 class Ollama {
 <<external system>>
 +chat(messages, model) response
 }

 FrontendApp --> ApiClient : fetches and creates
 FrontendApp --> QuestList : renders
 FrontendApp --> Quest : stores
 FrontendApp ..> QuestCreate : submits
 QuestList --> Quest : displays
 FastAPIApplication o-- QuestRoutes : registers
 FastAPIApplication o-- AIRoutes : registers
 QuestRoutes ..> Database : gets async session
 QuestRoutes ..> QuestService : delegates
 QuestService --> QuestRepository : uses
 QuestRepository --> QuestRecord : persists
 Database --> PostgreSQL : SQLAlchemy async
 AIRoutes ..> AIService : delegates
 AIService ..> ChatRequest : validates input
 AIService ..> ChatResponse : validates output
 AIService ..> AIServiceError : raises on failure
 AIService --> AIServiceApplication : HTTP POST /chat
 AIServiceApplication ..> AIChatRequest : validates JSON
 AIServiceApplication ..> AIChatResponse : returns JSON
 AIServiceApplication --> Ollama : HTTP /api/chat
 ChatRequest ..> AIChatRequest : matching wire shape
 ChatResponse ..> AIChatResponse : matching wire shape",
 "config": null,
